description: Sinter statistics behind the l = 9 circuit-level LER figure of the Supplemental Material. Each row is one task (mode, basis, p) with 10 noisy syndrome rounds, decoded by Relay-BP with a BP-LSD fallback (min-sum scaling 0.625); task metadata and custom counts are as written by sinter.

parent.sampling: each task stops at 200,000 shots or 100 logical failures, whichever comes first

topup.sampling: the eight p = 0.001 tasks extended towards 10,000,000 shots or 10 logical failures; the packet X extension was stopped early at 2,825,536 shots, all of which were decoded

aggregation_rule: Each top-up row replaces the parent row of the same task (same strong_id): its counts already include the parent's 200,000 shots, so the two must not be added.

failed shots by pattern of wrong observables ('E' = wrong); block observables first, then time-like surgery readouts
custom_counts.relay_nonconverged: shots on which Relay-BP did not converge (sent to BP-LSD)
custom_counts.lsd_solved: non-converged shots finalised by BP-LSD (equals relay_nonconverged)
